Extracts keywords, author, viewport, generator, theme-color, robots, lang, dir metadata

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from crawlberg import scrape, create_engine

async def main() -> None:
    engine = create_engine(None)
    url = "https://example.com"
    result = await scrape(engine, url)
    print(result.status_code)
    print(result.metadata.title)
    print(result.metadata.canonical_url)
    print(result.metadata.keywords)
    print(result.metadata.author)
    print(result.metadata.viewport)
    print(result.metadata.generator)
    print(result.metadata.theme_color)
    print(result.metadata.robots)
    print(result.metadata.html_lang)
    print(result.metadata.html_dir)

asyncio.run(main())
```
